decisions.reason: As a flagship cheese closely tied to the core assortment, several years of survival imply revealed demand and a low cost of continuation, so the option should be retained.
This semi-hard cheese fits existing capabilities and channels, and its continued presence after the trial phase suggests enough value to keep it unless portfolio simplification becomes necessary.

The mild creamy soft cheese remains within the firm's established organic cheese space, and while it is less strategic than the flagship line, keeping it still looks preferable to abandoning a likely viable niche product.
